name: Lyonnaise Potatoes
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: one and a half tablespoonfuls of butter
ingredients.originalText: one and a half tablespoonfuls of butter

ingredients.name: scant tablespoonful of chopped onion
ingredients.originalText: a scant tablespoonful of chopped onion

ingredients.name: cold boiled potatoes
ingredients.originalText: two cupfuls of cold boiled potatoes

instructions.text: Put one and a half tablespoonfuls of butter in a frying pan.
When melted add a scant tablespoonful of chopped onion; let it slightly color.
Add two cupfuls of cold boiled potatoes cut into dice.
Stir until the potato has absorbed all the butter, and become slightly browned.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and a tablespoonful of chopped parsley.
Mix well, and serve very hot.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put one and a half tablespoonfuls of butter in a frying pan.
2. When melted add a scant tablespoonful of chopped onion; let it slightly color.
3. Add two cupfuls of cold boiled potatoes cut into dice.
4. Stir until the potato has absorbed all the butter, and become slightly browned.
5. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and a tablespoonful of chopped parsley.
6. Mix well, and serve very hot.
